title: UI forms kit
summary: Forms: FormField (name → field-<name>), ErrorSummary, UnsavedChangesGuard, PasswordInput, DigitsInput, MoneyInput, AddressFields, SearchSelect, AsyncSearchSelect (server search, paging), HierarchicalSelect (tree), Segmented, MultiToggle, DatePicker (dd/mm/yyyy + calendar), DateRangePicker (presets), PeriodPicker (month), DateRangeFields, KeyValueEditor, FieldHint, FormSection/FieldGrid/StickyFooter/ActionRow, LineItemsEditor, FileDropzone, Stepper.
when_to_use: Any screen where people enter or edit data.
